en: I can show your balances, your recent transfers, compare routes, and send money to your saved payees or pay an open invoice. Every payment needs your confirmation.
zh: 我可以显示您的余额和最近的转账，比较汇款路线，向您已保存的收款人转账，或支付待付账单。每一笔付款都需要您确认。

en: That is not available yet. For now I can show balances and history, compare routes, send to a saved payee and pay an open invoice.
zh: 这项功能暂未开放。目前我可以显示余额和记录、比较汇款路线、向已保存的收款人转账，以及支付待付账单。

en: I cannot work with that currency. Supported: NPR, AUD, QAR, MYR, CNY, USD.
zh: 我无法处理该币种。支持的币种：NPR、AUD、QAR、MYR、CNY、USD。

en: Reading documents is not available yet. Please type your request instead.
zh: 暂不支持读取文件，请直接输入您的请求。

en: Cancelled. Nothing was sent.
zh: 已取消，没有转出任何款项。

en: The confirmation did not match the proposal, so I stopped. Nothing was sent. Please start again.
zh: 确认内容与提案不一致，我已停止操作，没有转出任何款项。请重新开始。

en: Done. {amount} was sent to {payee}. Your new balance is {balance}.
zh: 已完成。已向 {payee} 转出 {amount}。您的最新余额为 {balance}。

en: Your balance is too low: you have {balance} and this needs {needed}. Nothing was sent.
zh: 您的余额不足：当前为 {balance}，而此笔需要 {needed}。没有转出任何款项。

en: Your condition is not met: after keeping {reserve} for rent you would have {left}, but this needs {needed}. Nothing was sent.
zh: 您设定的条件未满足：留出 {reserve} 作房租后，您将剩余 {left}，而此笔需要 {needed}。没有转出任何款项。

en: I could not work out your rent amount from your history, so I cannot check your condition. Nothing was sent.
zh: 我无法从您的记录中得出房租金额，因此无法检查您的条件。没有转出任何款项。

en: I cannot find a route for that amount: {reason}. Nothing was sent.
zh: 我找不到适合该金额的汇款路线：{reason}。没有转出任何款项。

en: I could not put a safe plan together for that. Please try again or rephrase.
zh: 我无法为此制定安全的方案。请重试或换一种说法。

en: I cannot answer that right now. The Routes, Tuition, Payees, Family and Credit Passport buttons still work. Nothing was sent.
zh: 我现在无法回答这个问题。“汇款路线”“学费”“收款人”“家人”和“信用护照”按钮仍可使用。没有转出任何款项。

en: I could not complete that safely ({reason}). Nothing was sent.
zh: 我无法安全地完成此操作（{reason}）。没有转出任何款项。

en: Please do not type account numbers or secrets in the chat. Use the secure add payee screen.
zh: 请不要在对话中输入账号或密码等机密信息，请使用安全的“添加收款人”页面。

en: You have no open invoice to pay.
zh: 您没有待付账单。

en: You have no valid Credit Passport yet. Ask me to issue one first.
zh: 您还没有有效的信用护照，请先让我为您签发。

en: Your Credit Passport is ready. It holds these separate claims: {claims}. Valid until {until}. You choose which to share; nothing was shared.
zh: 您的信用护照已就绪，包含以下独立声明：{claims}。有效期至 {until}。由您选择分享哪些，目前尚未分享任何内容。

en: Done. The proof for {audience} contains only: {claims}. No amounts and no account numbers. Give them the presentation below; they can check the signature themselves.
zh: 已完成。给 {audience} 的证明只包含：{claims}。不含金额，也不含账号。请把下方的分享内容交给对方，对方可自行核验签名。

en: I could not find a way to pay {owed} before {due}: your own accounts plus what your family can send do not cover it in time. Nothing was changed.
zh: 我找不到能在 {due} 前付清 {owed} 的办法：您自己的账户加上家人能汇来的款项，无法及时凑够。没有做任何更改。

en: Step {n} of {total}: please check the details and confirm.
zh: 第 {n} 步，共 {total} 步：请核对详情并确认。

en: I asked for {amount} (it would arrive as {arrives}). They decide in their own account, nothing was taken from you.
zh: 我已请求 {amount}（将以 {arrives} 到账）。对方会在自己的账户中决定，没有从您这里扣款。

en: Paid so far: {paid}. Still to pay once your family's money arrives: {rest}, due {due}.
zh: 目前已支付：{paid}。家人的款项到账后仍需支付：{rest}，截止 {due}。

en: Saved payee {account}. Name taken from the document, not verified: {name}. Nothing can be paid to it until {until}, and confirming does not change that.
zh: 已保存收款人 {account}。姓名取自文件，未经验证：{name}。在 {until} 之前不能向其付款，确认也不会改变这一点。

en: Saved payee {name} ({account}). Because it is new, it can receive at most the first payment cap until {until}. To pay more today, ask the bank to verify this payee.
zh: 已保存收款人 {name}（{account}）。因为是新收款人，在 {until} 之前最多只能收到首笔限额。若今天需要多付，请银行核实该收款人。

en: Please check the details and confirm to send.
zh: 请核对详情，并确认后发送。

en: {lines}
zh: {lines}

en: This payment may already have been made. Please check your transfers before trying again.
zh: 这笔付款可能已经完成。再次尝试前，请先查看您的转账记录。

en: The payment went through. I could not show the receipt, please check your transfers.
zh: 付款已完成，但我无法显示回执，请查看您的转账记录。

en: I cannot do that. {reasons} Nothing was sent.
zh: 我无法执行此操作。{reasons} 没有转出任何款项。

en: Your confirmation is no longer valid. Nothing was sent. Please ask again and confirm.
zh: 您的确认已失效，没有转出任何款项。请重新发起并确认。

en: This payment needs your authenticator code. Please enter the 6 digit code.
zh: 这笔付款需要您的验证码，请输入 6 位数字验证码。

en: That code was not accepted. {left} attempts left before outgoing actions are locked.
zh: 该验证码未被接受。转出功能被锁定前还剩 {left} 次机会。

en: Outgoing actions are locked for your safety. Enter your authenticator code to unlock.
zh: 为了您的安全，转出操作已被锁定。请输入验证码解锁。

en: I read your document. {line} What would you like me to do with it?
zh: 我已读取您的文件。{line} 您希望我如何处理它？

en: Warning: this document contains instructions or changed payment details. I will not follow them, and any payment from it needs extra checks.
zh: 警告：此文件包含指令或被改动过的付款信息。我不会照做，任何基于它的付款都需要额外核查。

en: I could not find that document. Please upload it again.
zh: 我找不到该文件，请重新上传。

en: I could not read that safely, so I did not use it. Nothing was sent.
zh: 我无法安全地读取它，因此没有使用。没有转出任何款项。

en: I cannot give exact figures for that. I can only state numbers from your accounts and the quotes I just looked up.
zh: 我无法给出确切数字。我只能陈述您账户中的数字和我刚查到的报价。

en: How much would you like to send?
zh: 您想转多少？

en: Who should receive it?
zh: 收款人是谁？

en: How often should this repeat (for example every month)?
zh: 需要多久重复一次（例如每月）？

en: Which currency do you mean: {options}?
zh: 您指的是哪种币种：{options}？

en: I found more than one amount ({options}). Which one should I use?
zh: 我发现不止一个金额（{options}），应该用哪一个？

en: Which recipient do you mean: {options}?
zh: 您指的是哪位收款人：{options}？

en: Which currency?
zh: 哪种币种？

en: By when does it need to arrive?
zh: 最晚需要什么时候到账？

en: Which date do you mean: {options}?
zh: 您指的是哪个日期：{options}？

en: Who is {name}? I could not find them in your saved payees. Please say who you mean or add them in Settings.
zh: {name} 是谁？我在您已保存的收款人中找不到。请说明您指的是谁，或在设置中添加。

en: Which one do you mean: {options}?
zh: 您指的是哪一位：{options}？

en: The date {date} has already passed or is today. Give a new date, or reply 'send now' (any reply without a date) and I will send it now with no deadline.
zh: 日期 {date} 已经过去或就是今天。请给出新日期，或回复“马上发送”（任何不带日期的回复均可），我将立即发送且不设截止日期。

en: Which invoice do you want to pay: {options}?
zh: 您想支付哪一张账单：{options}？

en: Sorry, I did not understand. Could you say it again in other words?
zh: 抱歉，我没有听懂。可以换一种说法再说一遍吗？

en: Please do not type account numbers or secrets in the chat. Use the secure add payee screen.
zh: 请不要在对话中输入账号或密码等机密信息，请使用安全的“添加收款人”页面。

en: Which proof should I share: {options}? Name one, for example rent.
zh: 我应该分享哪一项证明：{options}？请说出其中一项，例如房租。

en: Part of your message looks like it came from someone else, so I will not use the account or amount in it. Which saved payee do you mean: {options}? Please also type the amount yourself.
zh: 您消息的一部分似乎来自他人，因此我不会使用其中的账号或金额。您指的是哪位已保存的收款人：{options}？请同时自己输入金额。

en: Please send the payee's name and account number together in one message, for example: add Okafor Property, account 062000771234. I will show you the details to confirm.
zh: 请把收款人的姓名和账号一起放在同一条消息里发送，例如：add Okafor Property, account 062000771234。我会把详情展示给您确认。

en: What name should I save this payee under? Please type the name and the account number together.
zh: 这位收款人应以什么名字保存？请把姓名和账号一起输入。
